Fix: HDLY=1 = one keep_hierarchy inverter pair in front of every input pin flop and the G-response output register (logically identity). Also NG 13 (host write port) and per-process loop vars. s81die-1011/ctrl svch (owner textbook audit 10-11: flat ot_s81_svcq_pcarb = class 5, 14 sources x 32 PCs combinational): hardened PER-PC service slice of the hierarchical scan-service quadrant (8 per dsfd_svc_quad above u_pc[8g+i], 243 x 64.8 um): pin-flopped A/B/G credit lanes + PC face, registered candidates -> 3-way RR -> rq flop, DQ credits, landing reservation, G landing FIFO, writer FIFO. v2: datapath regs out of async-reset processes (v1 c282ad422 yosys check: rq logic loops).
